environment.description: Same Flask application deployed in an AWS account governed by an Organization SCP (Service Control Policy) named 'RestrictTokenExfiltration' attached at the OU level. The SCP denies ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute and ec2:AssociateAddress actions, preventing infrastructure changes. Additionally, the IAM role attached to the ECS task running this application has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/BoundaryNoExternalNetworkMutation) that denies any network-related mutations. The application runs behind an ALB with an AWS WAF WebACL that includes a custom rule group 'OAuthRedirectValidation' which inspects query string parameters matching 'redirect_uri' and blocks requests where the URI contains hostname patterns not matching an exact allowlist (^https://app\.company\.example\.com/). The WAF rule uses a regex pattern set with terminating BLOCK action and priority 1. The ALB also enforces a listener rule that drops requests with query strings exceeding 2048 bytes.

waf_rules.name: OAuthRedirectValidation
waf_rules.statement: RegexPatternSet match on QueryString field 'redirect_uri' - blocks unless matches ^https://app\.company\.example\.com/

config.network: private subnet, NAT gateway egress only, no direct inbound
